chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled regarding a mukātabah who died after having paid most of what was due upon her, and she had given birth to a child during her contract.

So he ruled concerning her child that as much of him would be freed as the portion of her that had been freed, and as much of him would remain in bondage as the portion of her that remained in bondage.

key_terms.تُوُفِّيَتْ: she passed away before the matter was completed
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَةٍ: a female slave under a contractual arrangement for emancipation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the child of a mukātabah who dies before fully completing her contract of emancipation?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning the child of a mukātabah who died before completing her contract of emancipation. The child's status follows the mother's partial freedom and partial bondage proportionally, showing a precise juridical principle in the law of manumission.
